name: floppy
description: floppy is a cross-platform, peer-to-peer file-transfer application built with a Tauri 2 (Rust) backend, a SvelteKit + TypeScript frontend, and a Go rendezvous/pairing broker, using iroh for encrypted P2P transport. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.
